title: Metaphrase on Ecclesiastes (Cap. I tip)
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: MGR Greek (TLG 2063.006 / Documenta Catholica Omnia);. A opening; PG 10.987-989
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Metaphrasis in Ecclesiasten. I opening from locked MGR Greek. New English for private study; ANF 4 Crombie exists. Tip covers Solomon's address through careful consideration as king in Jerusalem.
era_note: Third-century metaphrase of Ecclesiastes transmitted under Gregory Thaumaturgus. Tip covers Cap. I opening only.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 4 Crombie, PD); this is a new rendering from locked Greek for the tipped opening.

text_history.method: English from locked MGR Greek Cap. A tip opening; ANF 4 consulted only as sense check; Vossius 1684 Latin DjVu OCR too damaged to lock as copy-text.

witnesses.name: Locked Greek Cap. A tip opening
